integrity: All-parameter argument is a disjoint rooted-support partition; direct small-instance enumeration and coefficient arithmetic are auxiliary checks. All published source dates are from documented first appearances.
scientific_limitations: Exact for all labeled q-ary sets of Hamming diameter at most two and n>=1; asymptotic fixes q. Existing binary total count already in OEIS A295922; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact size-refined enumeration of every diameter-two Hamming anticode
